title.english: Ruqayya, the female client of Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace

segments.arabic:
١١١٨٨- رقية مولاة فاطمة
بنت رسول اللَّه ﷺ.
عمرت حتى جعلها الحسين بن علي مقيمة عند قبر سيدتها فاطمة، لأنه لم يكن بقي
(١) يقال: قرف الذنب واقترفه إذا عمله، وقارف الذنب وغيره إذا داناه ولاصقه، وقرفه بكذا: أي أضافه إليه واتهمه به، وقارف امرأته إذا جامعها. النهاية. ٤/ ٤٥.
segments.english:
11188 — Ruqayya, the female client of Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace

She lived to such an age that al-Husayn ibn Ali made her reside beside the grave of her mistress Fatima, because there no longer remained—

¹ One says qarafa a sin, or iqtarafahu, when one commits it; and qarafa a sin or anything else when one draws near to it and adheres to it. Qarafahu with such-and-such means that he attributed it to him and accused him of it; and qarafa his wife means that he had sexual intercourse with her. al-Nihaya, 4/45.

segments.arabic: من يعرف القبر غيرها، قاله عمر بن شبة في أخبار المدينة.
segments.english: anyone other than her who knew the grave, as stated by Umar ibn Shabba in Akhbar al-Medina.
